correctness.rationale: The local rule tables define 4x4 Boolean transfer relations on overlapping predecessor pairs. A binary output has a cyclic predecessor iff the product of these relations has nonzero diagonal, valid even n=1,2. Independently regenerated the reachable deterministic relation automata (83 states for Rule 172, 34 for Rule 184), checked 83+34 exact scalar q(T) seed recurrences with q172=t^4-2t²-2t-1 and q184=t^4-2t³+1, and directly enumerated cyclic image sets for each n<=12; all agree. By Cayley–Hamilton the seed identities extend to all n>=1 and imply the rational generating functions and L_n-(-1)^n, L_n+1 formulas. Thus infinite proof uses a finite exact matrix argument, not a finite-census extrapolation.
